verdict.rationale: Canny documents Autopilot, which automatically pulls feature requests out of call transcripts and support or sales sources. Its first-party MCP server lets a user's LLM dig into top themes and ARR impact across ideas, which covers capturing raw feedback and surfacing high-impact opportunities. However, the AI analysis runs in an external LLM through MCP, and no native AI deduplication or impact ranking is documented. Missing for 10: explicit AI deduplication or merging of noisy feedback, native in-product AI prioritization of opportunities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities

citations.quote: Dig into top themes, ARR impact across ideas, and query your team's roadmap.
